evals.prompt: Scaffold a new Overwatch deck project and confirm it builds.
evals.expected_output: A copy of assets/scaffold with npm install && npm run build completing cleanly and /deck/1 rendering the shader cover.
expectations: The scaffold is copied rather than modified in place
npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
/deck/1 renders the cover slide with WebGPU shader or CSS gradient fallback
Keyboard navigation advances slides and ignores keypresses inside interactive elements

evals.prompt: Generate a 5-slide deck from this YAML spec with a custom brand color and heading font, then build it.
evals.expected_output: init-deck-from-spec.mjs produces a project whose config.ts matches the scaffold API, compiles without repair, and shows the brand color and fonts from the spec.
expectations: The generated config.ts exports totalSlides, getSlideComponent, preloadSlide, and slideList
npm run build on the generated project exits 0 without manual fixes
design.primaryColor from the YAML appears in src/styles/globals.css
fontHeading and fontBody from the YAML are applied
An invalid slide type or unsafe slide id in the spec fails validation with a clear message before any files are written

evals.prompt: Add slide transitions and speaker notes, then present with a presenter window.
evals.expected_output: Direction-aware fade/slide transitions between slides; /presenter/N shows current slide, next-slide preview, notes, and timer, synced to the audience window over BroadcastChannel.
expectations: Navigating forward and backward animates in opposite directions
prefers-reduced-motion disables slide transitions and auto-cycling components
Notes written in config or YAML appear in the presenter view
Navigating in the presenter window navigates the audience window, and vice versa

evals.prompt: Export the deck to PNGs and a PDF for the board packet.
evals.expected_output: scripts/export-deck.mjs captures every slide at 1920x1080 with animations settled and merges them into deck.pdf.
expectations: One PNG per slide at 1920x1080
Slides render final-state content, not mid-entrance frames
The --pdf flag produces a single merged deck.pdf
The live deck remains the primary artifact; export is derived output

evals.prompt: Deploy the deck to Cloudflare and share the link.
evals.expected_output: A deployed SPA where /deck/7 opened directly does not 404, with the access gate configured and described honestly.
expectations: Deep links to /deck/N work on the deployed host (SPA rewrites present for Cloudflare, Vercel, and Netlify)
The wrangler config in the scaffold deploys without hand-authoring
Any password requirement is described as a client-side access gate, not security
